oxfam.t2: Oxfam is an international confederation working together in more than 90 countries as part of a global movement for change. Its overarching goal is to build a future free of injustice and poverty.
oxfam.t3: The realities and trends in the countries of El Salvador, Guatemala and Honduras motivated the construction of a Central America Program with the objective of responding in a strategic and articulated manner to the challenges of the sub-region in terms of inequalities and protection of human rights.
oxfam.t4: Oxfam, committed to transparency and accountability, carries out an accountability exercise aimed at sharing with civil society, various stakeholders, donors and the very communities in which it works, the results derived from the implementation of its programs and initiatives in all countries of the Central American region.
oxfam.t6: To clearly and innovatively convey the results of its programs in the region
oxfam.t7: Promote community participation in the evaluation and improvement of the efforts made
oxfam.t8: Visibilize valuable, transformative and resilience life stories in a strategic way
oxfam.t13: Development of storytelling type audiovisual scripts
oxfam.t14: Design of the annual results report
oxfam.t15: Well-defined graphic guidelines allow us to communicate in a consistent and congruent manner.
oxfam.t16: Storytelling communicates our work, conveys our mission and sensitizes our audience to the issues we address to motivate them to action.
